fields.name: plan
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters the demonstration traces, written at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and copied unchanged at every later step. Derive it from the highlighted targets: the first highlighted target at demo t=0 is the start (this start marker may be labelled 'highlighted area' rather than 'highlighted target'; treat it as the first highlighted position all the same, and use its coordinates for the first dy/dx computation); each time a new target becomes highlighted during the demo, take dy = new y minus previous highlighted y and dx = new x minus previous highlighted x (using the coordinates at the first frame each appears). |dy| >= 8 with dy > 0 means forward, dy < 0 means backward; |dx| >= 8 with dx > 0 means left, dx < 0 means right; both over threshold means the diagonal (forward=A, backward=B, left=C, right=D, forward-left=E, forward-right=F, backward-left=G, backward-right=H). One letter per newly highlighted target, in demo order. Write the value as a JSON array of double-quoted letters with a space after each comma, exactly like the example: never single quotes (no Python-style ['E', 'D']), never bare letters. The same serialization is used at every step of every episode. e.g. ["E", "D", "G", "H"]

fields.name: moves_done
fields.description: How many of the planned moves the robot has finished executing by the scene at this step. 0 at the first decision step (nothing executed yet); at every later decision step it is the previous value plus one, since each decision step follows exactly one completed move. e.g. 2
